New Break Resources (NBRK.CN) announced on Friday that it plans to raise up to C$550K through a non-brokered private placement of 2.5M flow-through shares priced at C$0.22 each.
The flow-through proceeds will be used for eligible Canadian exploration expenses, which the company plans to renounce to investors by Dec. 31, 2026.
Moreover, the gross proceeds will fund ongoing drilling at the company's Moray gold project in Ontario.
Finders may receive a 6% cash fee and warrants equal to 6% of the flow-through shares they place. The warrants will be exercisable at C$0.22 for 24 months.
The offering is expected to close within two business days, subject to regulatory approvals.

title: New Break Resources plans C$550K financing to fund Moray gold drilling
